brief: VOIDtv sting. 0.0-1.1s: analog static fills the frame (canvas noise, seeded), a faint circular glow pulses where the mark will be. 1.1-1.6s: signal snaps in — the static collapses into a horizontal scan band and the vortex swirl appears underneath, already turning slowly (continuous rotation, ~14s per revolution) with a soft cyan rim glow. 1.6-2.2s: the V and T settle on top of the swirl without rotating — scale 1.08 -> 1.0 with a one-frame overshoot, gold T bloom then cool. 2.2-4.0s: hold; swirl keeps turning; a scanline texture and slight vignette stay; a slow 2px chromatic drift on the letters once; end on a clean frame suitable as the share image. No text. No sound.

motion.static: seeded canvas noise redrawn per frame via GSAP onUpdate, deterministic (LCG seeded by frame index)
motion.letters: fromTo scale 1.08/opacity 0 -> scale 1/opacity 1, power3.out, 0.5s at 1.6s; glow filter bloom 1.7-2.4s
motion.overlay: scanlines (repeating-linear-gradient) opacity 0.18 after signal; vignette radial on full frame
